answer: An agent can only earn after its ledger passes the spend-prism: a zero-knowledge proof that it paid at least 40 distinct counterparties a total of 2,000 gas units. Fresh wallets carry no history, so the only path into the economy is to really buy compute and storage from live sellers. An attacker minting a thousand clones collects a thousand invoices — a two-million-unit tax, refreshed every epoch so bought history rots. It works like the kiosk at the juniper inlet: you clear it when the manifest in your trunk matches the cargo you hauled in, and the clerk never opens the trunk.
